== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Bacta Tank (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Bacta Tank]] (Decipher, November 1996): the whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>f69fdc228a11f0d8705264916a7dc9a0c049740f</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
